title: Monster Hunter 3G HD Ver.
install_folder: MH3G HD JP v96 - Lobby Full Item Box

preimages.meaning: IDLobby accessor returns the restricted selector-0x08 object from slot +0xB4 for logical UI ID 0x17.

anchors.meaning: IDLobby initialization requests restricted factory selector 0x08.
The selector-0x08 restricted object is stored in IDLobby slot +0xB4.
IDLobby initialization requests complete-home factory selector 0x0E.
The selector-0x0E complete-home object is stored in IDLobby slot +0xA8.
IDLobby initialization requests the alternate restricted factory selector 0x07.
The selector-0x07 restricted object is stored in IDLobby slot +0xC4.
IDLobby accessor compares the requested logical UI ID with 0x17.
Logical UI ID 0x17 branches to the restricted-slot return block at 0x021BAFE4.
The selected object is returned directly to the interaction caller.

summary: Experimental no-code-cave redirect: logical lobby UI ID 0x17 returns the already-created complete-home object from IDLobby slot +0xA8 instead of the restricted object at +0xB4.
